name: horror nimbus
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically emits scintillating, multicolored light. Each creature within 15 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can see the light must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute.
A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Horror Nimbus for the next 24 hours.
